speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. As I examine this newborn, I need to know: Was there any trouble with the delivery, such as meconium aspiration or a difficult birth? 

Also, how long has the baby been having these breathing difficulties? 

Please tell me if the baby has been feeding well and if there are any color changes like turning blue or pale.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity. Given the gestational age of 32 weeks and C-section delivery without labor, the lack of surfactant production is the most likely cause. Please confirm if you have a Chest_X-Ray available to visualize ground-glass opacities.
